m: Wishing you a day full of joy, cake and laughter.

Every day with you is my favorite day.
Thank you for loving me the way you do.
Still choosing you, always.
Life is better with a friend like you.
Just a little note to say you matter to me.
Never change. The world needs your smile.
I truly appreciate everything you did.
Your kindness made a real difference.
Thanks a million. Coffee is on me!
So proud of you. You earned every bit of it.
